stage1.impression: A dark, symmetrical tunnel view through two heavy timber jambs into a slatted room where two glowing red speakers flank a multicolour neon-ring sphere. The far room has a mood, but the near half of the frame is flat brown jamb at lum 10, the two figures read as smooth mannequin blobs, not motion-blurred people, and the hard oval spot on the floor and the rainbow rings read as CG or nightclub, not a photographed room. As it stands it is a generic dark render, not a specific, well-made place a design magazine would publish.

blocking_9: The frame must show what the card says it is for: the lantern's slotted oak face, the lit amber band and the bar in the foreground. Today the porch jambs fill about 55% of the frame (x 0-310 and 855-1200) at lum_median 10 and none of the band or bar is visible.
Frame lum_median between 22 and 40 (now 11.4), with the near jambs and floor holding texture (lum_p5 > 3 rather than 0.2).

The speakers' regions [325,355,415,545] and [700,355,805,545] at lum_median >= 45 (now 16.6 and 16.2), lit from the front so the cabinets and drivers read, not only their glowing edges, and with clip_pct < 0.5 (now 1.4).
People must read as people blurred by motion (a hand, a glass, a sleeve), not as smooth dark capsules.
No hard-edged oval spot on the floor: Mother's spot must land on Mother and fall off softly.
The only saturated colour should be the Tropos pair; Mother's RGB rings compete (out of scope as an object, but their emission can be lowered so they do not dominate).

defects.what: Left porch jamb/door fills a quarter of the frame, flat smooth oak at lum_median 10, crush_pct 19, no grain at 1:1; reads as a CG wall.
Right jamb/door, same as left: lum_median 10.5, no texture, a dead frame-within-frame.
Hard-edged elliptical spot pool on the floor in front of Mother's plinth (lum_mean 68 against about 13 around it): a stage-light tell, and it misses its subject.
The seated figure is a smooth matte capsule with a ball head and stub arms: reads as a mannequin or game placeholder, not a motion-blurred person.
Left Tropos: the cabinet face is near-black (lum_median 16.6) and only the acrylic edges glow, clipping at 1.4%; the speaker reads as a red sign, not an object lit in a room.
Mother EARF's saturated blue, green, yellow and red rings are the brightest colour in the frame and read as neon or nightclub, competing with the speakers.
Two scalloped light marks on the lantern's ceiling (also at about 690,90-160): downlight cones grazing the ceiling, a CG artefact rather than a fixture.
Floor at lum_median 12.9, featureless; the end-grain oak or terrazzo does not read; no reflection or texture.
The right-hand chair is a plain box on thin legs, flat and unlit: reads as a placeholder.

changes.problem: The frame does not show what it is for: the porch jambs fill about 55% of it and the lantern's slotted face, amber band and bar are all out of shot.

evidence.measured: lum_median 10.0, crush_pct 19.4; right side [855,0,1200,800] lum_median 10.5; no band or bar visible anywhere

change.to: about 2.5 m further back (x ≈ 8.7) at seated or bar height 1.25 m, 28 mm, looking at [18.9, 4.3, 1.6], with a slice of the quartzite bar top and a glass in the lower-left foreground and the band and slotted face filling the top third

changes.expected: The porch opening becomes about a third of the frame width, framed by the lit slotted face and the amber band; the bar reads in the foreground; the room beyond stays the destination.

changes.problem: The frame is too dark: the near surfaces are crushed and the whole image sits below the night-interior range.

change.setting: render.exposure, and the lantern's band, the baffle's graze and the fill
change.from: exposure 3.2; band emission 0.12; baffle graze 0.6 W/m2; fill 0.05 W/m2
change.to: exposure 3.8; band emission 0.35; baffle graze 1.5 W/m2; fill 0.15 W/m2

changes.expected: Frame lum_median about 28, with the oak's grain legible on the lantern's face and the porch; the band glows amber without clipping.

changes.problem: The Tropos cabinets are dark with only their acrylic edges glowing and clipping, so they read as red signs rather than the lit hero objects.

evidence.measured: lum_median 16.6, lum_p95 151, clip_pct 1.43; right speaker [700,355,805,545] lum_median 16.2, clip 1.34

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair's spots
change.to: 2 x spot 90 W, 32 deg, 2700 K, aimed from about 1.5 m in front and 30 deg above each speaker onto the cabinet face, plus render clamp 10 to 6 to tame the edge hot spots

changes.expected: The cabinets' faces, the woofer cones and the tint read, with highlights below clipping; the speakers become the brightest coloured objects in the frame.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's spot lands as a hard oval on the floor in front of her plinth instead of on her, a stage-light tell.

evidence.measured: lum_mean 68.4, lum_p95 131 against floor lum_median 12.9 around it; hard edge visible

change.setting: inside the lantern: Mother EARF's spot
change.from: 1 x spot 80 W, 16 deg, 3000 K, aimed at the floor
change.to: 1 x spot 50 W, 22 deg with a soft edge (spot blend 0.6), 2700 K, aimed at Mother's centre so the pool lands on her and the plinth's top

changes.expected: No hard ellipse on the floor; Mother's plinth and the floor beneath it fall off softly; the floor region drops to near its surroundings.

changes.problem: The two figures read as smooth mannequin capsules, not people, so the frame has no sign of life.

evidence.measured: seen at 3x: ball head, cylinder body, stub arms, no clothing folds or hands; lum_median about 6

change.to: 2 rigged clothed figures (coat, sleeves, a hand on a glass), one at the bar in the foreground and one seated in the room, with a 0.3 to 0.5 m motion along a believable arc (turning the head, lifting a glass) so the blur has direction; keep shutter 1.0

changes.expected: The figures read as people half-seen in motion, giving the room scale and life without showing faces.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's saturated RGB rings are the most saturated colour in the frame and pull the eye from the Ember pair, reading as neon.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 129, blue and green rings saturated at 3x; the speakers' red reads secondary

change.setting: Mother EARF's own emission and spot (a light level, not her design)
change.from: rings at their current emission under an 80 W spot
change.to: ring emission about 40% of now, so she reads as a lit object first and a light second

changes.expected: The Tropos pair's red becomes the dominant colour; Mother stays present but quieter.

changes.problem: The porch's oak and the lantern's floor read as smooth CG surfaces with no grain, checks or wear.

evidence.measured: lum_range 21 over the jamb; at 2x a smooth gradient with faint stripes, no grain

change.setting: the oak's finish and the end-grain floor
change.to: oak with visible ray fleck and grain at real scale, a satin sheen (roughness 0.45) that catches the band's glow on its edges, and end-grain blocks on the floor with joint lines and slight tone variation

changes.expected: At 1:1 the timber reads as real oak; the jambs gain highlights on their arrises from the band.

changes.problem: The room inside is sparse and the chairs read as placeholders, so it is not yet cozy or lived in.

evidence.measured: a plain dark box on thin legs, lum_median about 12, no props anywhere in the room

change.to: a glass on the floor beside each chair, a record out of its sleeve leaning on the right plinth, a coat over the right chair's back

changes.expected: Signs of life in the room, small highlights on glass and vinyl in the pools of light.

out_of_scope.request: Mother EARF's multicolour rings make the frame read as a nightclub and break the one-colour rule.
out_of_scope.why: She is an EARF product placed as fixed; only her emission and light level can change (c6).

out_of_scope.request: The chairs inside the lantern look like generic placeholders.
out_of_scope.why: Furniture inside the lantern may be part of the fixed design; if not fixed, replace them with real upholstered listening chairs.

out_of_scope.request: The Tropos tint's glowing edge geometry reads close to signage.
out_of_scope.why: The speaker itself must not change; only its light (c3).
